desc: 珍珠纹卷筒洁面巾，干湿两用替代毛巾，断点撕取更便捷
leaf: 珍珠纹卷筒一次性洁面巾
name: 珍珠纹卷筒洁面巾干湿两用款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规立住主体
一秒传达亲肤纹理的核心卖点，承接点击
放大反复用旧织物擦脸的摩擦掉絮不适，制造替换动机
用干态与湿态的直观形变证明可用场景更广
代入清晨洗脸的真实台面，让买家自我投射
微距呈现压纹与纤维细节，证明亲肤质感
讲清断点撕取与卷筒形态，消除使用方式疑虑
用可验证的材质细节与留空证明位降低购买风险
以多卷组合收口促单，留出行动按钮位

style.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshot and trust, warm cream field #F5EFE2 for benefit, scene, spec and CTA, greige panels #ECE5D8 for the pain split, deep espresso backdrop #35302A reserved for the texture macro
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons only, single terracotta accent color
style.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting with a gentle front-left key, soft contact shadows, plus one controlled skimming side light reserved for texture close-ups
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm clean cotton facial-care visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cream base #F5EFE2, terracotta apricot accent #C97B5E, deep espresso text #35302A and muted sage-grey secondary #A9B6A2; bright soft studio lighting with a gentle front-left key and soft contact shadows, with one controlled skimming side light reserved for texture macros; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style; clean cotton-soft product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for the roll; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for the roll across the set; roll axis stays horizontal in group shots
style.surfaceSystem: matte warm-oat stone vanity counter and matte cream display plinths, one stepped deep espresso cylinder pedestal
